changeLog: v1.0 — Initial publication. Four-chip grid: (1) binding constraint label from workshopContext, (2) friction observation count from manifest.userStories.derivedFromFrictionIds, (3) regulatory anchor count from charter.regulatoryAnchors, (4) AES classification from charter.aesClassification. Cross-substrate widget spanning workshopContext (D-137), manifest (D-131+), and charter (D-134-v1.1+). Path discrepancy documented: spec listed charter.provenance.derivedFrom.derivedFromFrictionIds for chip 2 but that path is absent in FMT charter v1.3.1; manifest path used as canonical source with charter path retained as fallback.
